Tomato & spinach pasta

A quick skillet dinner with a short ingredient list.

Serves 220 minutes

Ingredients

  • 150 g dry fusilli
  • 1 tbsp olive oil
  • 2 garlic cloves, finely chopped
  • 200 g cherry tomatoes, halved
  • 100 g baby spinach
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 1/4 tsp black pepper
  • 2 tbsp grated Parmesan (optional)

Method

  1. Cook the fusilli according to its package directions. Reserve 1/2 cup of cooking water, then drain.
  2. Warm the oil in a skillet. Add the garlic and stir for 30 seconds. Add the tomatoes and cook for 5 minutes.
  3. Add the spinach, salt, and pepper. Stir for about 2 minutes, until the spinach wilts.
  4. Toss in the pasta. Add a little reserved cooking water if needed. Serve with the optional Parmesan.
Parmesan is optional. No substitution or dietary guarantee is implied by this recipe.
